03

Eight decisions to formalise

D1 · Commodity data

Bloomberg at the Business Library for daily FCPO, Newcastle coal and freight; free monthly series as the fallback; never the free daily palm series.

The free palm series is a monthly-average swap (section 5). Decision point: 31 October.

D2 · Universe

S$100k median daily traded value over the trailing year, applied point-in-time each month: 15 counters today.

Higher thresholds remove few names but cost power: with 12 counters the detectable IC over eight years rises from 0.07 to 0.09.

D3 · Horizons

Models predict 5- and 20-day residual returns; the strategy rebalances monthly and executes overnight information at the next open.

Round trips cost up to 2.1%; closes are unchanged on a third of days for the penny counters.

D4 · Machine learning

Four models as in Wijaya (2026): ridge, XGBoost, LSTM and TFT, with the TFT dropped first if time runs short.

Mirrors the prior work she supervised and adds a linear floor. The environment is installed and tested.

Ask whether she wants the deep models, given about eighteen counters.

D5 · Fundamentals

A sector-relative F-score ranking each reporting period, plus the panel test of what explains pass-through.

The brief asks for a ranking methodology. Free statements cover FY2021 onward only.

Ask whether the sector-relative version is acceptable as the stage 01 method.

D6 · Aim 1 framing

Commodity sensitivities are significant, drift over time and arrive partly the next day, but explain a minority of weekly variance, and removing them changes measured alpha.

Evidence above; most of the return is left for the FA, NA and TA layers.

D7 · News

Event studies on residuals with severity tiers, and the export-levy experiment as the headline test.

Large, surprising shocks move the residual; routine levy changes do not. Announcement timestamps must come from Bloomberg or Factiva.

D8 · Validation

The walk-forward record with bootstrap intervals is the evidence; the lockbox is a sign check; nulls are stated against their detectable effect.

An 18-month lockbox can only detect implausibly strong signals.

04

Questions for Prof. Wong

  1. Which title was registered on Stafflink before 5 October: the proposal's "An FA–NA–TA Trading Framework for SGX Energy and Commodity Equities", or an alternative?
  2. The interim report: its date, length and format, and what the video must cover.
  3. Is a sector-relative F-score ranking acceptable as the stage 01 method?
  4. Four models, as in Wijaya (2026), or ridge and XGBoost only?
  5. May Wijaya (2026) be cited as prior work in this group?
  6. Does EEE require a declaration on the use of generative AI tools in the reports?
  7. Any advice on Bloomberg terminal access, or data from previous students?
